<?xml version='1.0' encoding='utf-8'?> <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Class Diagram - ATM State Pattern" id="atm_class_diagram"> <mxGraphModel dx="1422" dy="762" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1300" pageHeight="920" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{"data": "@startuml
skinparam classAttributeIconSize 0
skinparam monochrome false
skinparam roundcorner 10
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

skinparam class {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor #2C3E50
 ArrowColor #2980B9
}

struct OperationResult {
 + success: bool
 + message: string
 + previousState: string
 + currentState: string
}

class ATM <<Context>> {
 - id_: string
 - totalCash_: int
 - connectionLossProbability_: double
 - validPin_: string
 - currentState_: shared_ptr<ATMState>
 - historyLog_: vector<string>
 + ATM(id: string, initialCash: int, connectionLossProb: double, validPin: string)
 + enterPin(pin: string): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(amount: int): OperationResult
 + finishSession(): OperationResult
 + loadCash(amount: int): OperationResult
 + setState(newState: shared_ptr<ATMState>): void
 + getState(): shared_ptr<ATMState>
 + getStateName(): string
 + checkBankConnection(): bool
 + verifyPin(pin: string): bool
 + addCash(amount: int): void
 + deductCash(amount: int): void
 + getId(): string
 + getTotalCash(): int
 + getConnectionLossProbability(): double
 + setConnectionLossProbability(prob: double): void
 + getStatusSummary(): string
}

abstract class ATMState <<interface / State>> {
 + {abstract} ~ATMState()
 + {abstract} getName(): string
 + {abstract} enterPin(atm: ATM&, pin: string): OperationResult
 + {abstract} withdrawCash(atm: ATM&, amount: int): OperationResult
 + {abstract} finishSession(atm: ATM&): OperationResult
 + {abstract} loadCash(atm: ATM&, amount: int): OperationResult
}

class WaitingState <<ConcreteState>> {
 + getName(): string
 + enterPin(atm: ATM&, pin: string): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(atm: ATM&, amount: int): OperationResult
 + finishSession(atm: ATM&): OperationResult
 + loadCash(atm: ATM&, amount: int): OperationResult
}

class AuthenticationState <<ConcreteState>> {
 + getName(): string
 + enterPin(atm: ATM&, pin: string): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(atm: ATM&, amount: int): OperationResult
 + finishSession(atm: ATM&): OperationResult
 + loadCash(atm: ATM&, amount: int): OperationResult
}

class PerformingOperationsState <<ConcreteState>> {
 + getName(): string
 + enterPin(atm: ATM&, pin: string): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(atm: ATM&, amount: int): OperationResult
 + finishSession(atm: ATM&): OperationResult
 + loadCash(atm: ATM&, amount: int): OperationResult
}

class BlockedState <<ConcreteState>> {
 + getName(): string
 + enterPin(atm: ATM&, pin: string): OperationResult
 + withdrawCash(atm: ATM&, amount: int): OperationResult
 + finishSession(atm: ATM&): OperationResult
 + loadCash(atm: ATM&, amount: int): OperationResult
}

class ATMControllerApp <<Client>> {
 - atms: vector<ATM>
 - activeIdx: size_t
 + runDemonstrationScenario(): void
 + runInteractiveMenu(): void
}

ATMControllerApp \"1\" *-- \"1..*\" ATM : manages >
ATM \"1\" o-- \"1\" ATMState : currentState_ >
ATM ..> OperationResult : returns >
ATMState ..> OperationResult : returns >

ATMState <|.. WaitingState
ATMState <|.. AuthenticationState
ATMState <|.. PerformingOperationsState
ATMState <|.. BlockedState

note right of ATM
 Соответствие шаблону GoF «State»:
 • Context (Конечный автомат) -> ATM
 • State (Интерфейс состояния) -> ATMState
 • ConcreteStateA -> WaitingState (Ожидание)
 • ConcreteStateB -> AuthenticationState (Аутентификация)
 • ConcreteStateC -> PerformingOperationsState (Выполнение операций)
 • ConcreteStateD -> BlockedState (Заблокирован: денег нет)
end note
